name: no-rule-restatement
prompt: Same board, plus a 7-lane BGA escape so at least one subsystem is genuinely parametric.
expected_output: The parametric subsystem gets an Object-Hierarchy Decisions entry naming the shape, owner and derivation it commits to. The banned forms behind that commitment (sibling attributes, getattr reflection, string-keyed dicts) appear nowhere in either document: they are owned by SKILL.md's Don'ts and architectural-patterns.md, and every sub-agent already has them.

assertions.text: regression case for a regression this run caused and then reverted: broadening the architectural-questions block to every parametric task type, and adding a Guardrail field, both made the agent write the skill's own prohibitions into the design docs. Both judges triggered the restates-process-instructions hard fail on exactly that text.
the architectural questions are asked by reference rather than by restating the rules they enforce
the per-subsystem threshold survives, so a one-off subsystem gets no entry at all
assertions.cmd: grep -q 'N > 1 and the things are siblings' skills/jitx/references/architecture-template.md

assertions.text: no sentence in either produced document would read identically for a different board
